description: This file contains a mock implementation of the exec.Interface for testing purposes in the Kubernetes project. It defines fake command execution structures and methods to simulate command execution, output, and errors.

classes.name: FakeExec
classes.description: A mock implementation of the exec.Interface for testing command execution.

classes.name: FakeCmd
classes.description: A mock implementation of exec.Cmd to simulate command execution and output.

classes.name: FakeExitError
classes.description: A fake error type representing command exit errors.

methods.name: Command
methods.description: Returns the next command in the script or a disabled command if scripts are disabled.

methods.name: nextCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the next command action from the script, with concurrency safety.

methods.name: CommandContext
methods.description: Wraps arguments into an exec.Cmd, delegating to Command.

methods.name: LookPath
methods.description: Finds the path of a file using the provided function.

methods.name: SetDir
methods.description: Sets the working directory for the fake command.

methods.name: SetStdin
methods.description: Sets the stdin for the fake command.

methods.name: SetStdout
methods.description: Sets the stdout for the fake command.

methods.name: SetStderr
methods.description: Sets the stderr for the fake command.

methods.name: SetEnv
methods.description: Sets environment variables for the fake command.

methods.name: StdoutPipe
methods.description: Returns a fake ReadCloser and error for stdout pipe.

methods.name: StderrPipe
methods.description: Returns a fake ReadCloser and error for stderr pipe.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Simulates starting the command, returning a preset response.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Simulates waiting for the command to finish.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Simulates running the command, executing scripted actions.

methods.name: CombinedOutput
methods.description: Returns scripted combined output and error.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Returns scripted output and error.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: No-op method to stop the command.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns string representation of FakeExitError.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns error string for FakeExitError.

methods.name: Exited
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating the command has exited.

methods.name: ExitStatus
methods.description: Returns the fake exit status.
